examples.arabic: هو كلم اصحابه بس هم رجعوا الفندق بدري
examples.english: He called his friends but they returned to the hotel early.
examples.transliteration: howa kalem ashabo bas homa regeo el fondoq badry.

examples.arabic: طيب هنشوف فندق كويس او بيت
examples.english: Okay, we will look for a good hotel or a house.
examples.transliteration: Tayyeb hanshoof fonde' kwayyes aw byt.
